title: pii-roundtrip: reversible anonymisation of Russian and UK English documents for external LLMs, and an open benchmark of existing tools
description: Engine, open benchmark and frozen held-out sets for reversible anonymisation (pseudonymisation) of Russian and UK English documents before they are sent to external large language models. The benchmark compares pii-guard, GLiNER Guard Omni, Microsoft Presidio, OpenAI privacy-filter, Prompt Anonymizer and pii-roundtrip on external datasets and on synthetic held-out documents frozen by SHA-256, with a logged run-once procedure and a full round trip through two local LLMs. The benchmark was run by the author of pii-roundtrip; code, data, results and run logs are released so that it can be reproduced.
